description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for schema transcoders, including functions for initialization, retrieval, and schema transcoding operations within the 'cslt' library, used for schema encoding/decoding support.
external_methods: const cslt_transcoder_t* cslt_get_transcoder_by_name(const char*, const char*)
const cslt_transcoder_t* cslt_get_transcoder(const cslt_factory_t*, const char*)
int cslt_transcode(const cslt_transcoder_t*, const char*, char**)
int cslt_transcode_preallocated(const cslt_transcoder_t*, const char*, char*, size_t)
int cslt_transcode_by_name(const char*, const char*, const char*, char**)
int cslt_transcode_by_name_preallocated(const char*, const char*, const char*, char*, size_t)
int cslt_transcode_by_schema(const char*, const char*, char**)
int cslt_transcode_by_schema_preallocated(const char*, const char*, char*, size_t)

classes.name: cslt_transcoder
classes.description: Represents a schema transcoder capable of decoding and encoding schemas, with validation and transcoding functions, and a version identifier.

classes.name: cslt_factory
classes.description: Provides a collection of transcoders for a specific encoder, acting as a factory to produce transcoders based on schema.

methods.name: cslt_init
methods.description: Initializes the schema transcoder library with optional settings.

methods.name: cslt_get_transcode_factory
methods.description: Retrieves a factory for a specific schema encoder to produce transcoders.

methods.name: cslt_get_transcoder_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves a specific transcoder based on decoder and encoder schema names.

methods.name: cslt_get_transcoder
methods.description: Retrieves a transcoder from a factory that supports a given schema.

methods.name: cslt_transcode
methods.description: Transcodes a schema using a specified transcoder, allocating new buffer if needed.

methods.name: cslt_transcode_preallocated
methods.description: Transcodes a schema into a preallocated buffer.

methods.name: cslt_transcode_by_name
methods.description: Convenience function to transcode schema by decoder and encoder names, allocating new buffer.

methods.name: cslt_transcode_by_name_preallocated
methods.description: Transcodes schema by decoder and encoder names into a preallocated buffer.

methods.name: cslt_transcode_by_schema
methods.description: Convenience function to transcode schema by encoder name and schema, allocating new buffer.

methods.name: cslt_transcode_by_schema_preallocated
methods.description: Transcodes schema by encoder name and schema into a preallocated buffer.
